title: Ex-Girlfriend is Convinced That Laws Don’t Apply To Her
description:
On a late Saturday night, officers responded to an apartment complex in reference to a disorderly female causing disturbance. The call was made by her ex-boyfriend who reported that she was banging and screaming outside his residence demanding he let her in. Apart from being openly hostile towards the officers, the female also had a strong odor of alcohol coming from her suggesting that she was pretty drunk. The female suffered a bloody injury to her chin when an officer slammed her face on the patrol vehicle. While she didn’t pay much attention to it and continued resisting, the officers finally noticed some blood splattered on the car’s window and decided to take the female to the hospital. At the hospital, two officers held the female down on the bed while the staff administered help. She continued resisting until she was sedated and restrained. The female was charged with aggravated battery on a law enforcement officer, aggravated assault on a law enforcement officer, and resisting arrest.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
